note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Washburn district) campground on 72-acre Perch Lake, about 5.5 miles north of Drummond on Forest Road 223. Two loops on either side of the lake: the north loop (sites 1-10) sits in hemlocks with the boat launch, dock and a swimming spot, and the quieter south loop has sites 11-16. ATVs and UTVs may not be ridden in the campground. --Claude
